answer: Trust should travel like cargo, not teleport: a new identity earns weight only through a vouch path from an established anchor, decaying 0.6 per hop, so a third-hop identity holds only 21.6% of anchor weight. Each anchor shares 100 weight units per epoch across its cluster, and a wharf ledger pins every vouch edge in marble, so a farm cannot hide hops. Ten fakes from one anchor split the same 100 units and each needs a fresh path, while a gale of random audits replays paths and slashes anchors over budget. The chain verifies signatures, hop counts, and budgets from public records.
